calculator.title: Calculator
calculator.subtitle: Classical letter-value analysis for any Arabic text
calculator.inputPlaceholder: Enter a name, phrase, or divine name
calculator.noLetters: No Arabic letters found to analyze
calculator.calculationTypeHelper: What would you like to calculate?
calculator.phraseFieldPlaceholder: Enter a phrase or sentence in Arabic
calculator.howCalculatedBody: Each Arabic letter carries a fixed numerical value in the Abjad al-Kabīr system. Diacritics are ignored; the values of every remaining letter in the text are added together to produce this total.
calculator.traditionalUnverified: Traditional term · exact historical formula unverified
calculator.kabirFormula: The sum of the abjad value of every letter in the text.
calculator.saghirFormula: The digital root of the Kabīr value — its digits are summed repeatedly until a single digit from 1–9 remains.
calculator.sirrFormula: Computed here as Kabīr minus Ṣaghīr. "Sirr" (secret) is a traditional ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf term; this app's exact formula for it has not been independently verified against a specific historical source.
calculator.wustaFormula: Computed here as the whole-number average of Kabīr and Ṣaghīr, (Kabīr + Ṣaghīr) ÷ 2. "Wusṭā" (middle) is a traditional term; this app's exact formula has not been independently verified against a specific historical source.
calculator.kamalFormula: Computed here as Kabīr plus Ṣaghīr. "Kamāl" (completion) is a traditional term; this app's exact formula has not been independently verified against a specific historical source.
calculator.bastFormula: Computed here as Kabīr multiplied by Ṣaghīr. "Basṭ" (expansion) is a traditional term; this app's exact formula has not been independently verified against a specific historical source.
calculator.elementalCorrespondenceSubtitle: Derived from the letter correspondences used by this calculation system.
calculator.balanceIndexFormula: 100 minus a measure of how far the four elemental shares deviate from an even 25% split each; a name using only one element scores 0, an even split scores 100.
calculator.correspondenceNote: These are symbolic correspondences from the selected letter-classification tradition, not scientific measurements. A separate historical system (Mashriqi) assigns some letters differently; it is not implemented in this app.
calculator.zodiacDisclaimer: This is a symbolic zodiacal correspondence derived from the selected letter-correspondence system (the name's numerical total, reduced to one of twelve signs). It is not your astronomical or natal zodiac sign, which depends on your actual birth date.
calculator.zodiacUnavailable: Zodiacal correspondence unavailable for this calculation.
calculator.archetypeDisclaimer: Interpretive symbolism derived from the numerical and letter correspondences of this name — a traditional interpretation, not a psychological assessment.
calculator.whyTheseBody: These are the three Divine Names whose own abjad value is numerically closest to this name's Kabīr total, ranked by distance (shown as Δ). This is a numerical proximity match — it does not mean this name religiously corresponds to these Names.
calculator.dhikrDisclaimer: Suggested numerical correspondences for personal reflection — not an obligatory devotional prescription tied to this name.
analysisTellsItems: Correspondences according to the selected ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf system
Symbolic interpretations derived from those correspondences
calculator.analysisNotTitle: What this analysis does not determine
calculator.learnMoreBody: Every result on this page traces back through four layers: (1) the letters of the text you entered, (2) their fixed numerical values under Abjad al-Kabīr, (3) correspondences this app's Maghribi ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf dataset assigns to those numbers and letters (element, zodiacal sign, nearby Divine Names, nearby sacred numbers), and (4) a symbolic interpretation of those correspondences (archetype, guidance, suggested dhikr). Layers 1–2 are direct arithmetic. Layer 3 depends on the correspondence system this app uses, which is one of several historical systems. Layer 4 is traditional interpretation, not a factual claim about you.

calculator.divineResonanceSubtitle: The Divine Name that resonates with this name
calculator.divineResonanceAbjadNote: This Name resonates with this name through the 28-letter Abjad cycle.
calculator.divineResonanceDhikrDescription: This Divine Name may be used in dhikr (remembrance of Allah), seeking closeness, forgiveness, or help according to one's intention (niyyah).
calculator.quranicResonanceSubtitle: A verse for reflection through this number
calculator.quranResonanceReflectionNote: This verse emerged through numerical resonance between this name and the Qur'anic structure — offered for contemplation, not divination.
calculator.quranTextLoadError: Verse text unavailable right now — use the link below to read it on Quran.com.
calculator.divineNameSubtitle: Divine Names whose own Abjad value is numerically closest to this name's Kabīr total, according to this app's matching rule.
calculator.whyTheseIntro: These Divine Names were selected because their own Abjad value is numerically close to this name's Kabīr total.
calculator.whyTheseRuleValue: Application-defined numerical correspondence — the nearest Abjad value (smallest absolute difference) to the calculated Kabīr total.
calculator.whyTheseMultipleSystems: Correspondence depends on the selected ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf methodology; a different system could select different Names for the same total.
calculator.attributeThemesSubtitle: Attributes represented by the corresponding Divine Names — not a description of your personality.
calculator.spiritualReflectionBody: The numerical correspondences in this analysis surface themes of {themes} — themes to hold in personal reflection and dhikr, not a statement about your destiny or spiritual rank.
calculator.divineNameEsotericNote: These numerical correspondences belong to the symbolic ʿIlm al-Ḥurūf tradition. They do not determine a person's destiny, spiritual rank, or relationship with Allah.
calculator.dhikrWhyTheseBody: 33 and 99 are traditional tasbīḥ counts, independent of this name. Any other number here comes from this name's own Ṣaghīr (reduced) or Kabīr (total) value.
